CustomField.description: Which suite the organization chose in the Setup Assistant: Nonprofit or Community. Held as text because a custom setting field cannot be a picklist (ADR-0019). Empty until someone chooses, and an empty value is never read as a choice (C-30, ADR-0046).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Nonprofit Suite or Community Suite: decides which modules the Setup Assistant offers.
CustomField.label: Suite
